items.title: List files in detail
items.body: ls -lah
items.description: Long format, human sizes, including hidden files.

items.title: Copy, move, remove
items.body:
cp -r src/ dest/
mv old.txt new.txt
rm file.txt
rm -rf dir/
items.description: Everyday file operations (rm -rf is permanent).

items.title: Make nested directories
items.body: mkdir -p {{path}}
items.description: Create parents as needed without errors if they exist.

items.title: Symbolic link
items.body: ln -s {{target}} {{link_name}}
items.description: Create a link at link_name pointing to target.

items.title: Disk usage
items.body:
df -h
du -sh * | sort -h
items.description: Free space per filesystem and the biggest items in a folder.

items.title: chmod: set permissions
items.body:
chmod 644 file      # rw-r--r--
chmod 755 script    # rwxr-xr-x
chmod +x script.sh  # add execute
chmod -R u+rwX,go-w dir/
items.description: Numeric and symbolic modes.

items.title: Permission numbers
items.body:
r = 4, w = 2, x = 1; add them per class (user, group, other)
7 = rwx   6 = rw-   5 = r-x   4 = r--   0 = ---
644 = user rw, others read     755 = user rwx, others rx
600 = private file             700 = private directory
items.description: How to read mode digits.

items.title: chown: change owner
items.body:
sudo chown {{user}}:{{group}} file
sudo chown -R {{user}}:{{group}} dir/
items.description: Set user and group, recursively if needed.

items.title: grep: search text
items.body:
grep -rniI "{{pattern}}" .
grep -v "exclude"   file     # invert match
grep -E "foo|bar"   file     # extended regex
grep -c "word"      file     # count matching lines
grep -rn --include="*.py" "TODO" .
items.description: Recursive, case-insensitive, with line numbers.

items.title: find: locate files
items.body:
find . -name "*.py" -type f
find . -type f -mtime -1            # modified in the last day
find . -size +100M                  # larger than 100 MB
find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \;
items.description: By name, type, age, size, and run a command on results.

items.title: sed: substitute and print
items.body:
sed -i 's/old/new/g' file.txt   # replace in place (GNU sed)
sed -n '10,20p' file.txt        # print lines 10-20
sed '/^#/d' file.txt            # drop comment lines
items.description: Stream edits.

items.title: awk: columns and sums
items.body:
awk '{print $1}' file            # first column
awk -F: '{print $1}' /etc/passwd  # custom separator
awk '{s += $3} END {print s}' f   # sum column 3
awk 'NR > 1 && $2 > 100' file     # skip header, filter
items.description: Pick fields and aggregate.

items.title: Processes: list and kill
items.body:
ps aux | grep {{name}}
kill {{pid}}          # polite (SIGTERM)
kill -9 {{pid}}       # force (SIGKILL)
pkill -f "{{pattern}}"
top                   # live view (q to quit)
items.description: Find, signal and watch processes.

items.title: Who is using a port
items.body:
lsof -i :{{port}}
ss -tulpn | grep :{{port}}
items.description: Find the process listening on a port.

items.title: ssh: connect and keys
items.description: Log in, make an ed25519 key and install it on a server.

items.title: ssh: port forwarding and copying
items.body:
ssh -L 8080:localhost:80 {{user}}@{{host}}   # local 8080 -> remote 80
scp file.txt {{user}}@{{host}}:/tmp/
scp -r {{user}}@{{host}}:/var/log/app ./logs
items.description: Tunnel a remote port and copy files with scp.

items.title: tar: create and extract
items.body:
tar -czf archive.tar.gz dir/       # create
tar -xzf archive.tar.gz -C dest/   # extract into dest/
tar -tf archive.tar.gz             # list contents
items.description: Archive and compress with gzip.

items.title: curl: download
items.body:
curl -fsSL https://example.com/file -o file
curl -fsSLO https://example.com/file.tar.gz   # keep remote name
curl -I https://example.com                   # headers only
items.description: Fetch files quietly, follow redirects, fail on HTTP errors.

items.title: cron: schedule a job
items.body:
crontab -e
# min  hour  day-of-month  month  day-of-week  command
*/5 * * * * /home/me/job.sh >> /home/me/job.log 2>&1
0 2 * * 1-5 /home/me/backup.sh   # 02:00 on weekdays
crontab -l                       # list
items.description: Edit your crontab; five time fields then the command.

items.title: Follow and inspect text files
items.body:
tail -f app.log
tail -n 100 app.log
head -n 20 file
wc -l file
less +F app.log
items.description: Tail logs, view the top, count lines.

items.title: Pipes and sort/uniq
items.body: cut -d, -f2 data.csv | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
items.description: Combine tools: unique sorted values with counts.
